_what: Keys openPASO names that do not resolve in the backend's own corpus.
_why: A baseline, not an allowlist. Every entry is a CANDIDATE awaiting triage, and each is either a real fabrication to fix or a correct negative the absence-cue matcher failed to recognise. The gate fails on anything NOT listed here, so a newly invented key is caught the moment it is written. Entries are removed as they are resolved; the list is meant to shrink to nothing.
_pruned_2026_08_07: Re-taken on the CONSOLIDATED corpus after feature/anti-fabrication was merged into consolidation/all-campaigns. 34 of the 68 entries now resolve and were removed, as test_baseline_only_shrinks requires — an entry that stays after its key is fixed silently re-permits the same fabrication if somebody reintroduces it. The prune is one-directional and every removal is a key the merged corpus fixed or stopped naming; 20 of the 34 are 4C keys corrected on this branch by 14f65097, 75af08d0, 1b6796b4 and 7608d060.
_not_baselined: The same re-take found 121 candidates that are NOT in this file, and they are deliberately left out: the gate is red for all nine backends until they are triaged. Adding them would make the gate green by making it blind, which is the failure mode the sibling test test_baseline_only_shrinks exists to prevent. Spot-checked, the 121 are four different things and only triage can separate them: (a) correct negatives whose phrasing _absence_asserted does not recognise — fourc REDAIRWAY is named precisely BECAUSE 'the spelling REDAIRWAY is rejected by the ParObject factory'; (b) real external symbols named in diagnostics but not input keys — XERBLA, DGEMM, SIGABRT, MPI_ABORT for 4C, the PETSc/SLEPc convergence-reason enums for fenics, the KRATOS_ERROR macros for kratos; (c) English-in-caps the stopword list does not cover — ABOVE, BEFORE, WHICH, NOTHING, EVERY, which dominate the febio and sparta lists; (d) genuine fabrications. At least one of (d) is present: kratos PARTICLE_FRICTION, served as a required DEM material key AND written into generated decks, is absent from the 28-application build — see the note in audit_quoted_diagnostics.py SOURCE_HINTS. The real keys are STATIC_FRICTION / DYNAMIC_FRICTION.

_pruned_2026_08_09: Emptied. The 91 candidates standing on this branch were triaged one by one and every one is now resolved at its source, so nothing is recorded here and the gate fails on anything at all. Four kinds of thing, and the split matters because only one of them was a defect in the knowledge: (a) 61 were ORDINARY ENGLISH shouted for emphasis -- ENTIRE, WIDESPREAD, WRONG, CHILDREN, case-SENSITIVE -- and are now covered by 60 distinct words in _PROSE_STOPWORDS, each screened against 4C's 2026 `4C -p` names, Kratos's 2675 variable macros and FEBio's 2437 registered strings, and held there by tests/test_named_key_stopwords.py. (b) 18 were REAL NAMES THE CORPUS COULD NOT SEE: Kratos's C++ source was missing (macros do not survive compilation, so KRATOS_ERROR and friends could never resolve against an install, and PFEM2/YIELD_SHEAR live in applications this host does not build), and the C headers under three Python bindings were missing (PETSc's KSP_DIVERGED_*, SLEPc's EPSWhich enumerators, dune-fem's Runge-Kutta names -- a C enum's NAME exists only in the header). Corpus paths fixed, never the assertion. (c) 7 were CORRECT NEGATIVES the absence matcher did not recognise, or identifiers belonging to openPASO rather than to a backend: PARTICLE_FRICTION and FREESTREAM_VELOCITY quoted the solver's own 'is unknown' / 'not defined' verdict, KRATOS_KNOWLEDGE quoted CPython's 'cannot import name', GENERATORS/KNOWLEDGE came from a module DOCSTRING that is not knowledge at all, and FEBIO_BINARY is our own environment variable. (d) 3 were REAL DEFECTS IN THE KNOWLEDGE, fixed in the text: dune's DIRK22 (no such scheme -- dune-fem accepts ImplicitEuler, CrankNicolson, DIRK23, DIRK34, SDIRK22, timestepcontrol.hh:154), febio's EROSION (the registered type string is lower-case `erosion`, FEAMR.cpp:49), ngsolve's BDM_1 (maths notation, not an NGSolve name; the space is HDiv(order=1, RT=False)), plus DYN_VISCOSITY, which is not one of the 91 because it was not in the knowledge at all but in THIS GATE'S OWN DOCSTRING, cited as the example of a real 4C parameter. 4C's MAT_ParticleSPHFluid spells it DYNAMIC_VISCOSITY and DYN_VISCOSITY appears in zero files of src/, apps/ and tests/. Two more, SUPG and BDF2, are English-in-caps that could NOT be stopworded because both are real 4C identifiers; those two entries were reworded instead. 61 + 18 + 7 + 3 + 2 = 91, nothing unclassified.
_open_defect_2026_08_09: key_present matches SUBSTRINGS, so a fabricated key that sits inside a real identifier resolves and is never reported. Measured: DIRK22 resolves against the letters of SDIRK22, which is why the dune fabrication above was found by reading the header and not by this gate. `grep -w` fixes it and is already implemented -- key_present tries whole-word FIRST and reports every substring-only resolution in the `substring_only` field on every run. It is not yet the pass/fail rule because switching it on surfaces 63 further candidates across all nine backends INCLUDING 4C (fourc 16, febio 11, dealii 8, fenics 7, ngsolve 7, sparta 7, skfem 3, kratos 3, dune 1), and shipping 63 untriaged reds -- or parking them in this file -- would be worse than shipping a named limitation. They are printed by name on every run, so the next pass starts from a list.
